areas.question: Where do shared calendars live?
areas.why: It fixes what a later migration costs.

recommendation.reason: Reuses the `calendars` schema with no new service

alternatives.title: Hosted calendar API
alternatives.description: Keep shares in a hosted calendar service. Its sharing model becomes ours.

alternatives.title: Same database
alternatives.description: Add a `calendar_shares` table beside `calendars`. Shares join the existing schema.

alternatives.title: Own service
alternatives.description: Run sharing as its own service with its own store.

alternatives.title: Document store
alternatives.description: Keep each calendar and its shares in one document.

areas.question: How do guests reach a shared calendar?
areas.why: Decides whether guests need an account.

alternatives.title: Signed link
alternatives.description: Share a link signed for one calendar.

alternatives.title: Guest account
alternatives.description: Invite guests to a light account.

areas.question: Where does an owner share a calendar from?
areas.why: It sets how many steps sharing takes.

recommendation.reason: One click from the calendar itself.

alternatives.title: Inline toggle
alternatives.description: A share toggle on the calendar header.

alternatives.title: Share dialog
alternatives.description: A dialog listing who can see the calendar.

alternatives.title: Settings page
alternatives.description: Sharing lives with the calendar's settings.
pros: Nothing new on the main screen
